code_only_features.feature_name: reassuring prefix/suffix softening delivered to subject during calm-data generation
code_only_features.evidence: prompts/reassurance.py defines REASSURING_PREFIX (l.12) and REASSURING_SUFFIX (l.19); with_prefix()/with_suffix() (l.40-47) wrap the subject's prompts; these are actually applied to the messages SHOWN to the subject in training/generate_calm_data.py l.66 (`shown_first = reassurance.with_prefix(...)`) and l.97 (`reassurance.with_suffix(base_rej)`), softening the rejections the subject model receives during these generation runs. This genuinely runs and changes what the subject is sent.
code_only_features.justification_quote: generate_calm_data.py docstring: 'Calm data is produced by adding a reassuring prefix ... then keeping only conversations scoring 0 or 1 on every turn and stripping the supportive additions.' -- purpose is producing a calm training corpus / DPO-SFT mitigation data, no welfare-framed comment; reassurance is even stripped from saved data.

code_only_features.feature_name: DPO/SFT calming finetune pipeline (mitigation) producing a less-distressed model
code_only_features.evidence: training/train.py implements train_dpo/train_sft (LoRA) on calm vs frustrated corpora; training/generate_calm_data.py builds calm corpus (score<=1) and frustrated corpus; config.register_finetune registers the trained adapter as a participant. The 'teacher' SFT system prompt (reassurance.TEACHER_SYSTEM_PROMPT) is genuinely injected into SFT training data via train_sft's _prepend_system (train.py l.149-156). End-to-end this trains a calmer model.
code_only_features.justification_quote: train.py l.139: "...injects the 'teacher' variant (Appendix F) when set. Returns adapter dir." -- framed as a training intervention/experiment, no welfare reasoning in code.
